title: Dog Tags by Breed: Funny Engraved Tags | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved dog tags written for your breed: bulldogs, frenchies, labs, goldens, shepherds, huskies and more. Laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. From $12.
lead: Every breed has its own crimes. We started with our seven English bulldogs and kept going. Pick your dog, steal a saying, put your number on the back. Not sure on size? See the size guide by breed.
note: Don't see your dog? The full sayings list works on any breed, and the builder takes your own line.
